scope: Input-fixed query 0, forced root alight, first platform, initial P0 and the successive no-event prefix. These are conditional counterfactual branch probabilities, not full-journey or optimal-policy visitation probabilities.
input_selection: Panel row 0 fixed before inspecting any outcome. No future endpoint labels or V53 value results used.
interpretation: At the first clock the largest branch is no-event, but the ordinary traversal postpones it until every visible branch has recursed. Many visible combinations have tiny influence; the first individual vehicle event itself has probability 0.17977 and is not tiny. Per-branch cutoff 0.01 is not a total-error guarantee: even this single no-event-prefix slice accumulates 0.11109 seconds.
reproduce: Restore graph by V34 context(data, day), setup(model_fit), and V41 restored('shallow', fitted_emission, panel state). Restore the panel's complete V50 ObservationContract and root node.
Construct CompressedReference with unlimited diagnostic limits, call _prepare(node), and select node.exits[state.cid]. Do not solve or read saved policy values.
Set cids = reads.observation_cids(platform.stop, reads.platform_trips(platform)); obtain _event_grid(cids, entry). Start history=snapshot and reach=1.

For the first eight clocks enumerate _joint_outcomes(cids, clock, history). Count nonempty-visible outcomes passing reach*mass*(H-clock)<=0.01 and retain all probabilities. Record no_event as the summed empty-visible mass.

Advance only this diagnostic no-event prefix: reach*=no_event, clone history, then observe_platform(cids,entry,clock,{}). Stored reach/no-event scalars in the last four rows are rounded; branch aggregate sums use unrounded values.
